hero.title: AI That Finishes the Transaction, Not Just the Conversation
hero.subtitle: Through function calling, your AI agent executes actions mid-chat: composing complete orders, sending payment links, and calling your own systems over API. Customers never get told to switch apps.

definition: Function calling in Cekat.AI is the AI agent's ability to invoke real functions while a conversation is happening: creating orders from chat content, issuing payment via payment links or manual transfer, and executing actions in external systems over API.

stats.label: to set up a bot, no code

benefits.title: Chat Becomes an Order Without Touching a Dashboard
benefits.body: The moment a customer commits, the AI collects the name, address, and order details from the conversation and creates the order. No copy-paste into another system, no order lost to a busy admin.
benefits.imageAlt: AI creating an order straight from a conversation

benefits.title: Shipping and Couriers Handled Inside the Conversation
benefits.body: Make the shipping address mandatory or optional, choose the sender address and courier. The AI calculates and confirms all of it before the order is created, without leaving the chat.
benefits.imageAlt: Shipping configuration inside the AI order flow

benefits.title: The Bill Goes Out the Moment They Say Yes
benefits.body: Choose auto-generated payment links or route to the bank accounts and e-wallets you register. The riskiest gap in any sale, between agreeing and paying, shrinks to a single message.
benefits.imageAlt: Payment link sent automatically in chat

benefits.title: Call Your Own APIs
benefits.body: Function calling does not stop at orders. Connect your stock, booking, or internal system APIs and the AI can check and act on them mid-conversation, like an employee with system access.
benefits.imageAlt: AI calling an external system API

benefits.title: Every Channel, One Execution Path
benefits.body: Orders from WhatsApp, Instagram, or website live chat run through the same flow. Configure the function once and every channel you sell on gets it.
benefits.imageAlt: Function calling running across every channel

pillars.title: Action, Not Just Answers
pillars.body: An AI that only replies still leaves work behind. Function calling means conversations end with something done.

pillars.title: You Hold the Rules
pillars.body: Which functions can be called, when an address is mandatory, where payments route: all of it is yours to set.

pillars.title: Recorded in the Same System
pillars.body: Every order and payment the AI executes lands in the CRM and the chat history, so the team can trace all of it.

faq.q: What is function calling in Cekat.AI?
faq.a: The AI agent's ability to invoke real functions mid-chat: creating orders from the conversation, issuing payment, and executing actions over API. The AI acts rather than only answering.

faq.q: How is it different from Order Automation?
faq.a: Order Automation is the order flow itself; function calling is the machinery that lets the AI execute that flow and other actions beyond orders, including custom functions over API.

faq.q: How does the AI know what data to collect?
faq.a: From the function's configuration. For orders, it asks for customer details, the address when you make it mandatory, and confirmation, then calls the function once everything is complete.
Two modes: a payment link generated automatically per order, or manual payment routed to the bank accounts and e-wallets you register yourself.

faq.q: Can the AI call APIs beyond the built-in features?
faq.a: Yes. Through the Open API you register your own functions, stock checks, schedule bookings, or internal system queries, and the AI calls them when the conversation needs to.

faq.q: What happens when a function call fails?
faq.a: The failure is visible in the conversation rather than swallowed silently, so the team can step in. The case can escalate to a human agent with full context.

faq.q: Do we need a developer to turn it on?
faq.a: Not for orders and payments; enable it from the Integrations tab and set the options from the dashboard. A developer only comes in when you connect your own custom API.
Every chat channel connected to Cekat.AI, including WhatsApp, Instagram, and website live chat. Configure a function once and it applies across channels.
